title: Colby and Jack Mousse Naan Bites
description: A fusion of Indian naan and French mousse, these bite-sized treats are perfect for any occasion. With the creaminess of mousse and the tanginess of Colby and Jack cheese, every bite is a delight.
instructions: Combine the gluten-free flour and salt in a mixing bowl.
Gradually add the ghee or vegetable oil to the flour mixture and knead to form a smooth dough.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal portions and shape each portion into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 6 inches in diameter.
Brush the edges of each naan with a little water and top with a dollop of velvety mousse.
Sprinkle shredded Colby and Jack cheese over the mousse.
Fold the naan in half to enclose the filling and press the edges to seal.
Place the naan bites on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove from the oven and garnish with chopped cilantro.
